correctness.rationale: For |z|=r and h(t)=f''(tz)/M, the integral moments A=integral t h, B=integral(1-t)h, C=B-A satisfy C=-integral t(1-t)h'; Schwarz-Pick and 1-|h|²<=2(1-Re(xibar h)) give |C|<=1-2|A|. Taylor identities imply (p-1)/(2-p)=Mz A/(1+Mz C), so |(p-1)/(2-p)|<=m/2; constant Schur functions yield every point in the Möbius disk, including its boundary. For a=m/2 the exact denominator-minus-numerator identity for |P_m(w)^2-1|² is (1-2a²+2a Re w)²+2a²(1-6a²); it is strictly positive when m<sqrt(2/3). Re P_m>0 from |P_m-1|<1. At a=1/sqrt(6), Re w=-sqrt(2/3) yields exact tangency, and a slightly larger quadratic datum escapes. M<=sqrt(2/3) has full unit radius. An independent symbolic expansion, 31 Schur monomials and exact tangency independently checked. No analytic argument relies on these finite checks.
